item.title: Show HN: Cermet – allow github.push where owner = "suarezc" and name = "cermet"
item.summary: I was having fun building with Claude, I was having less fun knowing it had access to all my projects in Github through the CLI and gh. You put your token in the Cermet daemon, you write your parameters in the SQL-eqsue prose, your agent can only do those things. Right now it supports a healthy subset of Github and Stripe operations and lets you deploy through Vercel. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49347614 Points: 1 # Comments: 1
